headline: Denmark Supreme Court rules eviction of non Western tenants under housing law is not discriminatory
label: NEWS
caption:
Denmark top court has upheld a controversial housing law allowing the eviction of non Western residents. 🇩🇰

According to Al Jazeera, the Supreme Court ruled on Monday that terminating leases of non Western tenants under the country housing legislation does not constitute ethnic discrimination.

The judges rejected an appeal by seven families whose leases were ended in 2022, concluding that the non Western category provided in the law is a neutral criterion.

Under the 2018 legislation, social housing estates where more than half of residents are non Western must alter their social mix, forcing about 11,000 people to relocate by 2030.

Danish Housing Minister Jacob Mark said he was satisfied with the ruling, stating that the law strengthens integration and social cohesion.
